selected.title: Run the gate that covers this change
selected.question: Each site names its coveringGate — the gate over the artifact this change invalidates. You do not choose it and must not answer about a different one (ADR 0098). Determine wiredBy for that gate by reading, not running — grep the .husky hooks, the .github/workflows jobs, and the yarn gates:run manifest (tools/scripts/run-assertion-gates.mjs) at the head commit for the gate's script name, and write the one that invokes it, or "none" if nothing does (ADR 0074). command and exitCode are optional: record them only when you also ran the checker's own script directly through node, never through yarn or corepack yarn; when you did not run it, write "not run" in both. Cite wiredBy: the file, the line number, and the exact text of the line that invokes the gate; a wiredBy of "none" carries no citation, because nowhere has no line.
selected.defect: wiredBy "none" is a finding: per ADR 0074 the checker is not a gate, so nothing would have caught this on main. A non-zero exitCode, when one was obtained, is also a finding, with the command and exit code as executed evidence — raised the ordinary way (an obligation answer that exposes a defect is written up like any other finding), not mechanically by defectWhen, because exitCode is optional and its "not run" value cannot be told apart from a real code by a plain equality check.
